+always wrong.) Standard formulas (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, INDEX/MATCH, SUMPRODUCT, EOMONTH, …) recalculate and
+pass — SUMPRODUCT with `--(condition)` factors is the reliable way to do multi-condition math.
+BUT the recalculation engine does NOT reliably evaluate these, which come back BLANK / 0 / just the
+first element and score 0:
+  - dynamic-array / spilling functions (FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, SEQUENCE, spilling XLOOKUP), or any
+    array-entered formula that spills across several cells;
+  - an array-entered ("CSE", Ctrl+Shift+Enter) formula that returns a SINGLE value into ONE cell —
+    e.g. `MATCH(1,(A2:A9=x)*(B2:B9=y),0)` multi-condition matching, `SUM(COUNTIFS(rng,{">","="}&0))`
+    or ANY formula containing an in-line array constant in `{...}`, and newer functions such as
+    NUMBERVALUE / TEXTJOIN / other `_xlfn.*` functions. openpyxl writes every formula as an ORDINARY
+    (non-array-entered) string, so the engine evaluates these as if they were not array-entered and
+    the cell comes back wrong — even though the same expression works when you type it into Excel
+    with Ctrl+Shift+Enter.
